414:t_031:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I can! That's what my wings are for!!」

414:t_031:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「My wings are here to protect what matters to me!!」

414:t_033:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's all right. $$ブレラ$$ would never just stand there on a battlefield.」

414:t_033:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「He came to his senses just as I shot him down.」

414:t_033:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「It seems he did. $$ブレラ$$ has sent a message requesting retrieval.」

414:t_034:1.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「...I understand. I will follow your guidance.」

414:t_035:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Is that $$ストライカー#pilot$$ joining the $$ギャラクシー船団$$!?」

414:t_035:2.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$, we have a message from Mr. $$フランジ$$. The fighting in the $$霧の海$$ has ended too.」

414:t_035:3.en:
$$ラム$$
「He says the holdouts surrendered when they heard $$ストライカー#pilot$$ had fled.」

414:t_035:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They've lost their god... I hope they can decide how to live for themselves...」

414:t_035:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー#pilot$$ has left my detection range.」

414:t_035:6.en:
$$レド$$
「We don't need to pursue her, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. She isn't the only enemy we must fight.」

414:t_035:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand. I will follow Ensign $$レド$$'s judgment.」

414:t_036:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Are you sure you want a failed soldier like me?」

414:t_036:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「According to $$ストライカー#pilot$$, I too was judged unfit as a support and enlightenment system.」

414:t_036:2.en:
$$レド$$
「But I don't intend to stop fighting.」

414:t_036:3.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll fight as a member of $c until I find what I really ought to do.」

414:t_036:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「My future mission is to continue supporting Ensign $$レド$$.」

414:t_036:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I hope you will achieve even greater results, Ensign.」

414:t_036:6.en:
$$レド$$
「I still can't do that on my own. Let me rely on you a little longer, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

414:t_036:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand. Ensign $$レド$$'s survival is the very reason I exist.」

414:t_037:3.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm home, $$エイミー$$. I'm home, $c...」

414:t_038:0.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Stay out of this, pirate. Once I purge Ensign $$レド$$, I will punish you.」

414:t_039:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「This is as far as I go. $$アンタレス１$$ is withdrawing.」

414:t_040:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll stop you for $$ランカ$$'s sake too!」

414:t_040:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Can the likes of you do that?」

414:t_040:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I can! That's what my wings are for!!」

414:t_040:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「My wings are here to protect what matters to me!!」

414:t_041:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Remember, $$ブレラ$$! Remember what matters most to you!」

414:t_041:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are you going to lose to your $$インプラント$$ and hurt the person you care about most all over again!?」

414:t_041:6.en:
$$シビル$$
「Are you going to sing, $$バサラ$$!?」

414:t_042:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Is listening to $$バサラ$$'s song causing him pain...!?」

414:t_042:3.en:
$$ルカ$$
「No, it isn't! The $$フォールドウェーブ$$s in $$バサラ$$'s song are probably affecting $$ブレラ$$'s control system!」

414:t_042:5.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Come on, $$ランカ$$! You too, $$シェリル$$!」

414:t_043:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Ugh... aah...! My head... no, my chest... is burning up!」

414:t_043:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let your heart burn! That's who you really are!!」

414:t_043:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's $$ランカ$$'s song! Those are the feelings of the person you care about most!!」

414:t_044:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「It looks like you're yourself again, $$ブレラ$$.」

414:t_044:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...I see. They were controlling me again...」

414:t_044:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「But you're all right now. $$ランカ$$ and the others broke their hold over you with their songs.」

414:t_044:4.en:
$$ルカ$$
「The $$フォールドウェーブ$$s and $$ブレラ$$'s own resistance probably destroyed the system completely.」

414:t_045:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I've caused you trouble again, $$アルト$$.」

414:t_045:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry about it. Go talk to $$ランカ$$. She's waiting for you.」

414:t_045:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'm sorry, $$ランカ$$. And thank you.」

414:t_045:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'll fight them too, of my own free will.」

414:t_046:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「A soldier finds happiness in obeying orders and achieving results in battle. Nothing else is necessary.」

414:t_046:1.en:
$$レド$$
「That's how the $$人類銀河同盟$$ forced every human being to live as a soldier!」

414:t_046:2.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「That is the best choice for society and for the individual.」

414:t_046:3.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「You're wrong, whoever you are, $$ストライカー#pilot$$.」

414:t_046:4.en:
$$レド$$
「We're human beings before we're soldiers...! No one has the right to take that way of life from us!」

414:t_100:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Securing superior combat strength will be difficult. I recommend hit-and-run tactics. Concentrate your attacks on the enemy's head.」
